scientific_claim: Chemical filtering can enrich T relative to U through differential hydrolysis stability in dark hydrothermal-vent conditions. UV is negligible in this environment (zero-UV control differs by <2%). The model does not demonstrate Darwinian evolution. The CSI decomposes multiplicatively as CSI = real T-pref enrichment * pool-drift factor. Both factors are environmental. The stability ratio k_U/k_T is an Arrhenius extrapolation, not a measurement; see the Ea_T sweep for its uncertainty.

optimization_results.stability_ratio_label: extrapolated (25 C refs -> 90 C; Ea_T assumed 32 kcal/mol; see ea_T_sweep for uncertainty)
